subject: CCollisionData struct layout — the struct pointed to by CColModel::m_pColData
overview: CCollisionData holds the actual geometry arrays for a model's collision mesh. CColModel.m_pColData (offset +0x2C in CColModel) points to a heap-allocated CCollisionData. The struct is filled by LoadColVer2 @0x537300 and LoadColVer4 @0x537490 and freed by CColModel::RemoveCollisionVolumes @0x537070.
evidence_sources: LoadColVer2 @0x537300: writes all count fields and pointers into the newly allocated CCollisionData

CCollisionData_layout.description: Layout proven from field access pattern in LoadColVer2 and RemoveCollisionVolumes.

fields.name: m_nNumSpheres
fields.note: Written as word from ESP+0x40 (the sphere count from the COL file header)

fields.name: m_nNumBoxes
fields.note: Written as word; second count field in the COL header

fields.name: m_nNumTriangles
fields.note: Third count in COL header. COL2/3 formats use a triangle array.

fields.name: m_nNumLines
fields.note: Line (suspension wire) count. Written as byte.

fields.name: m_nFlags
fields.note: Flags byte. bit 0: has sphere data; bit 1: has box data; bit 2: has mesh/triangle data. RemoveCollisionVolumes tests bit 2 via `test byte [esi+7], 4`.

fields.name: m_pSpheres
fields.note: Pointer to array of CColSphere structs (m_nNumSpheres entries)

fields.name: m_pBoxes
fields.note: Pointer to array of CColBox structs (m_nNumBoxes entries)

fields.name: m_pLines
fields.note: Pointer to suspension line data (m_nNumLines entries)

fields.name: m_pTriangles
fields.note: Pointer to triangle index array (m_nNumTriangles entries)

fields.name: m_pTrianglePlanes
fields.note: Pre-computed plane equations for each triangle. Allocated separately by call to 0x536910; set to null if not computed.

fields.name: m_pSuspectLines
fields.note: Zeroed by RemoveCollisionVolumes: `mov dword ptr [edx + 0x1c], edi` (edi=0). Exact type unknown — may be a re-slice pointer into an existing allocation.

fields.name: m_nNumSuspectLines
fields.note: Written to CColData[+0x20]. Probably the count for the m_pSuspectLines array.

fields.name: m_pShadowMesh
fields.note: Shadow mesh pointer, set by the return value of call 0x536910 (CColShadowMeshAllocator). If no shadow mesh, set to null (0x5370C5).

fields.name: m_nAllocatedCount
fields.note: Written at CColData[+0x28]. Exact semantics unclear — may be the total count of allocated collision volumes (spheres+boxes+triangles) for bulk-free purposes.

fields.name: m_pDataBuffer
fields.note: At +0x2C: a re-slice pointer computed as `ecx + eax - 0x48` in RemoveCollisionVolumes. Likely points into the same contiguous allocation for the beginning of the geometry data, used to identify the start of the freeable block.

alloc_pattern.description: CCollisionData is NOT a C++ new — it is allocated from a suballocated data block. The geometry arrays (spheres, boxes, triangles) are packed into one contiguous heap block. The pointers in CCollisionData are all into this single block, which is freed with one call when the CColModel is released.
alloc_pattern.note: `lea edi, [ebp + 0x30]` — EDI is set to CCollisionData + 0x30, then used as the destination for `rep movsd` which copies the sphere/box data directly into the struct at that offset. This confirms that the geometry arrays are stored inline starting at +0x30, not as separate heap allocations.
